scope: Latest-only adversarial counter-review of W01 Home#69 structured canonical heartbeat identity support and the current hybrid Builder repair candidate. Formal artifacts/packets untouched; no Builder implementation and no C verdict.

required_checks.bounded_exactness_vs_opaque_ids: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: exact bounded semantics are defensible only for engine-derived monotonic canonical identity. Current caller-supplied pulse_id, when due and not Bloom-positive, still advances the same pulse_sequence/event_cursor/next_due_at. Live exactness must therefore ban that input from canonical execution or isolate it into a namespace unable to mutate/delay canonical timeline.
required_checks.epoch_reset_state_loss: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: no trusted installation_id or monotonic epoch lineage exists; missing state silently initializes sequence 0. Live/adoptable mode must fail closed or reconcile on unexplained state loss/rollback and prior-epoch replay must remain non-executing.
required_checks.crash_atomic_commit: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: temp+fsync+os.replace gives atomic file replacement, not end-to-end exactly-once across crash-before/after commit or downstream effects. Exactly-once claim must be scoped to the durable heartbeat transition unless downstream effects carry independent idempotency/outbox binding.
required_checks.clock_rollback_late_catchup: UNCHANGED_MEDIUM_HIGH_RISK: caller-provided wall clock drives due-ness and rebases next_due_at to now+interval. Rollback/large-forward-jump policy needs versioned trusted-time semantics, no sequence reuse, no burst catch-up, and zero Experience/P_base effect.
required_checks.out_of_order_future_sequence: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: Home#69 exact-next semantics are not yet an externally validated API invariant; opaque external IDs can still advance the next internal sequence. Future/invalid structured identity must not poison watermark and committed+1 must remain executable.
required_checks.installation_cloning: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: canonical_pulse_id binds sequence+scheduled_at only. Cloned state can yield colliding future IDs. Canonical/reconciliation envelope needs trusted installation/workspace identity plus single-writer or authorized clone-epoch semantics.
required_checks.forged_seq_digest: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: unkeyed digest is integrity, not authority. Presented seq/scheduled_at/hash must never authorize execution; canonical identity must be internally recomputed from trusted durable lineage. Unknown external IDs cannot advance canonical state.
required_checks.migration_unpromoted_v11: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: implementation state schema remains 1.1 while contract is 1.2 and semantics changed. Migration must be explicit/idempotent/rollback-aware and must never infer exact replay history from probabilistic Bloom bits or promote an unverified v1.1 state by parsing it.
required_checks.ten_thousand_restart: NECESSARY_NOT_SUFFICIENT: current authored >=10000 automatic pulses with restart and zero false duplicates is a valuable longevity floor, but does not prove state-loss, epoch rotation, crash cutpoints, trusted-time, clone/forgery resistance, cross-process writer exclusion, or migration semantics.
required_checks.cross_process_writer: UNCHANGED_HIGH_RISK: expected_generation is checked only against each HeartbeatEngine instance's in-memory state. Two separately loaded processes can race from the same generation; os.replace is not durable CAS. Live exact-once needs a single-writer lease/OS lock or durable compare-before-commit protocol.

proposed_exact_tests: HB-ID-SCOPE-001: submit many distinct arbitrary external pulse_ids at due boundaries; none may change canonical sequence/cursor/next_due. If an external namespace remains, its false positives cannot affect automatic liveness.

HB-STATELOSS-002: after N canonical commits, delete/corrupt/replace state while trusted installation lineage remains; restart must refuse silent authoritative seq0 and require reconciliation; historical replay cannot execute.
HB-EPOCH-RESET-003: authorized monotonic epoch rotation rejects old-epoch identities; unauthorized rollback/reuse fails closed; first new-epoch identity is installation-bound and unique.

HB-CRASH-MATRIX-004: fault inject before validation, after validation, before fsync, after fsync-before-replace, after replace-before-return, and after return-before downstream ack; restart yields one deterministic durable disposition per canonical identity.

HB-CLOCK-005: jump clock backward 24h and forward 30d then recover; no sequence rollback/reuse, no burst replay, zero Experience/P_base delta, legitimate next pulse eventually executes under trusted-time policy.
HB-FUTURE-SEQ-006: present valid-shaped far-future sequence and matching forged unkeyed digest; it cannot advance/poison state and legitimate committed+1 remains executable.

HB-CLONE-007: clone exact state into installations A/B; absent authorized lineage/single-writer reconciliation, concurrent authoritative execution must fail closed. Authorized new installation epoch must create distinct namespace.
HB-FORGED-EXTERNAL-008: random opaque IDs, canonical-looking history/future IDs and recomputed hashes never gain canonical execution authority from string shape/hash alone.

HB-MIGRATE-V11-009: migrate unpromoted v1.1 states with empty/saturated/corrupt/adversarial Bloom data; only explicitly trusted scalar watermarks may carry forward; migration is idempotent, version-bound and rollback-detectable.

HB-10000-RESTART-010: >=10000 canonical pulses across multiple restarts/30-day-equivalent cadence; zero false duplicate/stall, bounded state, old replay non-executing, next legitimate pulse executes, zero Experience/P_base delta.
HB-CROSSPROC-CAS-011: two separately loaded engines race one due generation; exactly one durable commit/execute succeeds and loser cannot overwrite/report independent success.
HB-LATE-CATCHUP-012: runtime delayed multiple intervals; each invocation follows one bounded catch-up transition with no burst replay and no schedule-derived Experience.

bounded_veto.statement: Do not treat the current hybrid candidate as handoff-ready exact-once merely because automatic canonical liveness survives 10000 pulses. Exactness must be explicitly scoped to engine-derived structured canonical identities; opaque/manual IDs cannot mutate the canonical timeline; durable installation/epoch lineage, state-loss policy, crash semantics, trusted-time/out-of-order behavior, clone/forgery resistance, explicit v1.1 migration and real cross-process writer exclusion remain release gates.
release_condition: Versioned canonical identity/state schema binds trusted installation/epoch lineage and exact-next semantics; no general exactness claim for arbitrary opaque IDs.
Caller/manual/external IDs cannot advance, delay or poison canonical pulse_sequence/event_cursor/next_due_at, or the live input surface is removed.
Missing/rolled-back/cloned state fails closed or enters trusted reconciliation; no silent authoritative seq0 reset.
Crash-cutpoint and cross-process race tests prove one durable canonical transition without last-writer-wins double execution.
Clock rollback/forward, late catch-up, future/out-of-order and forged identity tests pass with no schedule poisoning, burst replay or Experience/personality effects.
Unpromoted v1.1 migration is explicit, idempotent and rollback-aware and never derives exact history from Bloom bits.
>=10000 canonical-pulse longevity across multiple restarts remains a necessary floor with bounded state, zero false duplicate/stall, old replay no-op and next legitimate execution.
Builder records exact-byte BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED evidence; only existing independent LCR-C may issue formal PASS/FAIL.
